hero.title: How to sign up with Vantro
hero.answer: It takes about five minutes: your details, a quick ID check and a deposit limit. You can bet as soon as you are verified.

items.title: Enter your details
items.text: Full name, date of birth, residential address, email and mobile number.

items.title: Verify your identity
items.text: Vantro checks your details electronically. If that fails, upload a driver licence or passport.

items.title: Set a limit and deposit
items.text: Choose a daily, weekly or monthly deposit limit, then deposit from A$10. PayID is instant.

items.title: Be 18 or over
items.text: And live in Australia. Vantro verifies both before you can bet.

items.title: Photo ID, just in case
items.text: Driver licence or passport, only if the electronic check cannot confirm you.

items.title: A bank account
items.text: In your own name, for PayID, BPAY or debit card payments.

text.html:
Why Vantro checks your identity

Australian wagering providers must verify every customer's identity and age before they can bet. Vantro runs the check electronically against official records, so most people never need to upload anything.

What happens if the check fails

You will be asked for a photo of your driver licence or passport. Manual checks usually take under an hour during business hours. You can browse markets while you wait, but you cannot place a bet.

One account per person

Each person can hold one Vantro account. If you already had one and closed it, contact support to reopen it instead of signing up again.

After you sign up

Set up your deposit method on the payments page, or get the Vantro app to bet on your phone.

items.q: Do I need to upload ID?
items.a: Usually not. Most accounts are verified electronically within minutes.

items.q: Can I sign up in the app?
items.a: Yes. The steps are the same on the website and in the app.

items.q: Why must I set a deposit limit?
items.a: Australian rules require you to be offered a deposit limit at sign-up. You can choose any amount and change it later.

items.q: Can I change my email or phone later?
items.a: Yes, under Account → Details. Name and date of birth changes need support.

final.title: Open your account
final.text: About five minutes, then you are ready to bet. 18+ only.

methods.title: Every way to pay at Vantro
methods.note: Credit cards and crypto cannot be used for online wagering in Australia.

text.html:
Depositing

Choose PayID for instant deposits from your banking app. BPAY takes one business day. Debit cards and Apple Pay are instant.

Withdrawing

Withdrawals go back to a bank account in your name. PayID is the fastest; card withdrawals take one to three business days.

  • Minimum withdrawal: A$10
  • No fees from Vantro
  • Your first withdrawal may need your identity to be fully verified

Why no credit cards

Since June 2024, Australian law bans credit cards and digital currency for online wagering. Vantro accepts debit cards, PayID, BPAY and Apple Pay only.

Deposit limits

You can set a daily, weekly or monthly deposit limit at any time. Lower limits apply immediately; higher limits after a cooling-off period. See safer gambling for all tools.

items.q: Why is my withdrawal pending?
items.a: First withdrawals can wait for identity checks. After that, PayID withdrawals usually take about an hour.

items.q: Are there fees?
items.a: Vantro charges no deposit or withdrawal fees. Your bank's own fees may apply.

items.q: Can I withdraw to a different account?
items.a: No. Withdrawals go only to an account in your own name.

items.q: What is the minimum deposit?
items.a: A$10 for every method.

final.title: Deposit with PayID
final.text: Instant deposits, withdrawals in about an hour. 18+ only.

hero.title: Safer gambling at Vantro
hero.answer: Set a deposit limit, take a time-out or exclude yourself with BetStop. Free, confidential help: 1800 858 858.

text.html:
Deposit limits

Choose a daily, weekly or monthly limit under Account → Limits. Lower limits apply straight away. Increases wait seven days.

Time-outs

Take a break from 24 hours to six months. You cannot log in or bet until the time-out ends, and it cannot be reversed early.

BetStop self-exclusion

BetStop is the National Self-Exclusion Register. Registering excludes you from every licensed Australian online wagering provider for three months to life. Register at betstop.gov.au.

Getting help

Gambling Help Online offers free, confidential support 24/7: call 1800 858 858 or visit gamblinghelponline.org.au.

If gambling stops being fun, stop. Help is free and confidential.

items.q: Can I cancel a time-out early?
items.a: No. A time-out stays in place until the end date you chose.

items.q: Does BetStop cover all betting sites?
items.a: It covers every licensed Australian online and phone wagering provider.

items.q: Will Vantro contact me during a time-out?
items.a: No. Marketing stops while a time-out or self-exclusion is active.

items.q: Is the help line really free?
items.a: Yes. Gambling Help Online is free, confidential and open 24/7.
